author: Amir Salihefendić
text:
This mock of Todoist's weekly calendar view is so exciting! 

Fundamentally, this will enable completely new uses for Todoist. For example, much better weekly planning and time blocking. There are, of course, many details to figure out... But it has never been more exciting to be a Todoister!

topReplies.author: Amir Salihefendić
topReplies.text:
You can read and watch more about what we are up to in the Todoist Bulletin for January: 
https://
todoist.news/2024%5F01

topReplies.author: Eric
topReplies.text: Damn you all are shipping like crazy this last year! This looks great.

topReplies.author: Amir Salihefendić
topReplies.text: You could already re-create this using a board, where each column is Today, Week, Month, Year, Life?

topReplies.author: Victoriano Izquierdo
topReplies.text: super nice! it would be great if one manually could block this as events in a Google Calendar :)

topReplies.author: Mahir Anand
topReplies.text: this is absolutely lovely Amir. Releasing this anytime soon?

topReplies.author: Amir Salihefendić
topReplies.text: The plan is to release and iterate with real feedback. Be sure to enable experimentalist features

topReplies.author: rich
topReplies.text: Would it be possible to have an integration between Hey Cal and Todoist, which doesn't show the tasks without a time as all-day tasks?

topReplies.author: Amir Salihefendić
topReplies.text: Integration with Hey is not planned, but we might add it at some point if it takes off
